items.difficulty_reason: The proof assembles a global diagram by taking coproducts of the local data, then runs an explicit four-step reduction (make $X$, $Y$, $V$, $U$ schemes in turn, each step justified by one of the three assumed localities) before applying the scheme-side descent criterion. The bookkeeping of which locality justifies which reduction step is the substance.
